stage.title: Stage
stage.random.desc: One is picked when the match starts.
stage.bosque.name: Training Forest
stage.bosque.desc: Overgrown ruins and stone paths in daylight.
stage.cenizas.name: Ashen Fortress
stage.cenizas.desc: Dark walls, torches and glowing cracks under an ash sky.
stage.mareas.name: Tidal Sanctuary
stage.mareas.desc: A temple by the water with a waterfall, reflections and blue light.
stage.bastion.name: Primordial Bastion
stage.bastion.desc: Monumental columns, a stone colossus and mineral crystals.
stage.viento.name: Gardens of the Wind
stage.viento.desc: Raised bridges, banners and clouds pushed by air currents.
stage.equilibrio.name: Arena of Balance
stage.equilibrio.desc: A tournament arena with the symbols of the four elements.
